fullPassage: Digital twins are digital replicas of assets or activities using modeling and sensors to create digital representations. Digital twins are not new; engineering teams in various industries have used 3D renderings of computer-aided design models, asset models, and process simulations for years. However, faster wireless networks and the resulting availability of real-time data enable much more detailed and dynamic digital representations. When sensors collect data from a connected device, the sensor data can be used to continuously update the digital twin. The digital twin becomes a real-time accurate copy of a physical object’s properties and states. Similarly, the twin fails to capture emotional or cultural factors, limiting discussions beyond strictly technical contexts. For instance, digital twins of physical assets such as power-generation turbines, jet engines, and train engines are becoming common when the assets are very valuable and when downtime would be very costly.

questions.passage: Digital twins are digital replicas of assets or activities using modeling and sensors to create digital representations. Digital twins are not new; engineering teams in various industries have used 3D renderings of computer-aided design models, asset models, and process simulations for years. However, faster wireless networks and the resulting availability of real-time data enable much more detailed and dynamic digital representations. When sensors collect data from a connected device, the sensor data can be used to continuously update the digital twin. The digital twin becomes a real-time accurate copy of a physical object’s properties and states. Similarly, the twin fails to capture emotional or cultural factors, limiting discussions beyond strictly technical contexts. For instance, digital twins of physical assets such as power-generation turbines, jet engines, and train engines are becoming common when the assets are very valuable and when downtime would be very costly.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean:

③ 무선 네트워크 기술의 흥망성쇠
④ 물리적 자산이 쓸모없어지는 이유
det.analysis:

❌ ② A Beginner's Guide to 3D Rendering Software(3D 렌더링 소프트웨어 초보자 가이드): 실습 가이드가 아니에요

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 "beyond strictly technical contexts"가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 트윈이 감정적/문화적 요소를 포착하지 못하기 때문에, 그것에 관한 논의는 결국 기술적인 성능·수치 이야기에만 머무를 수밖에 없다는 뜻이에요.

✅ ② 기술적 성능 지표로만 한정된 논의를 벗어나지 못한다: 감정/문화 요소를 못 담아내니 논의가 기술적 영역에 갇힌다는 의미와 정확히 일치 ←정답

❌ ④ 기술적 맥락과 인간적 맥락을 동등하게 다룬다: '동등하게'가 아니라 기술적 맥락에 '갇힌다'는 뜻이에요
det.tip: limiting discussions beyond strictly technical contexts = 논의를 기술적 맥락 '너머로' 나아가지 못하게 제한한다는 뜻이에요.

det.korean: 자산이 매우 가치 있을 때 가동 중단은 매우 비용이 큰(very costly) 일이 된다는 내용이에요.

det.tip: to + 부사 + 동사원형 순서: to continuously update처럼 부사가 동사 바로 앞에 올 수 있어요.

questions.passage: However, faster wireless networks and the resulting availability of real-time data enable much more detailed and dynamic digital representations. When sensors collect data from a connected device, the sensor data can be __________ (use) to continuously update the digital twin.
questions.stem:

However, faster wireless networks and the resulting availability of real-time data enable much more detailed and dynamic digital representations. When sensors collect data from a connected device, the sensor data can be __________ (use) to continuously update the digital twin.

det.korean: 동사 use(사용하다) → can be 뒤에서 수동태를 만드는 과거분사 형태 필요 → used.
det.analysis: ✅ used: use(원형) → can be used(조동사+수동태). the sensor data가 '사용되는' 대상이므로 수동태(be + p.p.)가 필요해요.
det.tip: 조동사(can/will/must 등) + be + 과거분사 = 조동사 수동태. use → used
